description: A Guest bringing a plus-one must name them; the plus-one name field stops being optional. This interacts with ADR 019eebb3-f8db (a named plus-one write-back mints a first-class Guest): the issue must define what 'declining the plus-one' looks like so a Guest attending without their plus-one is not forced to invent a name.
title: Plus-one name becomes required
notes: The plus-one-decline boundary interacts with ADR 019eebb3-f8db; flagged for the architect at pull-time.
acceptance_criteria: A Guest who brings a plus-one must name them; the plus-one name field is required, not optional
A Guest attending without their plus-one can decline it and is not required to enter a name
The declining-the-plus-one behavior is defined and consistent with ADR 019eebb3-f8db's named plus-one write-back
